Our collective ambitions to #3xRenewables is critical to keep 1.5°C within reach. However, current NDCs cover only 12% of this target, and with the next round of NDCs due in 2025, this offers an opportunity to place advancing an energy transition as a priority for NDCs. ☀️

On the session “Pathways to Energy Integration in NDCs,” co-hosted by @‌IRENA and @Ocean Conservancy, I highlighted three key opportunities to make NDCs ambitious and actionable, focusing on scaling sustainable renewable energy:

1. Support countries in creating bankable energy projects integrated with their NDCs, ensuring these plans are actionable and backed by comprehensive sectoral investment analyses.
2. ⁠Promote financial innovation & implement tools like credit guarantees and blended finance, facilitating debt-smart energy transition financing in developing countries.
3. ⁠Leverage digital technologies to help identify optimal investment opportunities, ensure optimized off-grid solutions & enable data-driven policymaking.

UNDP and United Nations Capital Development Fund (UNCDF) are supporting these efforts by scaling up capital for renewable energy and developing innovative guarantee schemes that provide safety nets for investors and lenders, reducing perceived risks to move renewable energy projects from pipeline to financial closure.
